baselineNote: Includes the checkout's pre-existing uncommitted changes. Before measurements were taken before this optimization pass.

methodology.median: Sorted sample at index count / 2 (upper middle)
methodology.timingIncludes: Model operations and identical correctness assertions; excludes fixture creation and compilation.
methodology.fixture: Each View contains a horizontal group of three browser surfaces, selected member, and group/leaf weights.

workloads.projection_and_layout: Project all Views with no excluded surfaces and compute all layouts in a 1200x800 frame.
workloads.bulk_arrival: Reconcile viewCount new native surfaces into a new View alongside the existing browser Views.
workloads.organization_edit: Prepare a validated move of one three-surface group into another View, including owner effects and selection.

limitations: Synthetic model timings, not end-to-end interaction or display latency.
No installed-app restart, live-browser validation, or memory/battery measurements.
Final release run started after the app build and test suite finished.

changes: Reuse the unchanged tree for layout projections with no matching exclusions.
Transfer arrivals together and prune metadata once before appending them in owner order.
Share direct structural validation between decoding and live edits, removing JSON round trips.
Reuse membership maps for reservations and selection, sorting only changed owner effects.
